## Checklist

- [ ] No figure is invented, estimated or filled in; every number traces to a published source
- [ ] Missing or withheld data is explained, not shown as zero or as a clean record
- [ ] Cost and rent are not presented as grades
- [ ] `site/data.json` and `data/out/` were produced by `bash pipeline/run.sh`, not edited by hand
- [ ] For data changes: three landlords spot-checked against the source by hand
- [ ] Checked on the preview: a full landlord card, a small-landlord card and a borough card
